objective: Test whether binding the normalized projected address into recurrent RWKV k/v/a/b write features makes the sparse DeepEmbed hybrid materially address-specific without opening native generation or protected data.

authorization_basis.observed_failure: The trained sparse DeepEmbed endpoint passed zero and layer-permuted controls but donor-minus-correct mean CE was -0.0037399953, so generation remained blocked.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Condition recurrent write features on the selected projected address instead of increasing another readout or FFN gain.

architecture.write_slot_binding: The one projected proposal route is expanded over valid write tokens and used as the RWKV state-slot route.
architecture.write_address_source: The selected L2-normalized 64D projected slot key is folded parameter-free into 32D as (first_half + second_half) / sqrt(2), then expanded over valid write tokens.
architecture.identity_controls: Zero write-address gain or a zero address returns the pre-existing RWKV write features exactly.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_correct: Correct projected carrier plus address-keyed correct recurrent bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_zero_recurrent: Correct projected carrier with every recurrent tensor zeroed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_matched_donor_recurrent: Correct projected carrier with an address-keyed write-length-matched donor recurrent bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct projected carrier with address-keyed recurrent bundles cyclically shifted across all 42 layers.
causal_conditions.ffn_gain_zero: Correct projected and recurrent bundles with DeepEmbed FFN gain set to zero.
causal_conditions.write_address_gain_zero: Recompute the correct recurrent bundle with the same slot route and projected carrier but no address injection.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient synchronization or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately locked causal training run on the open development prefix with zero, matched-donor, and layer-permuted controls.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the signed failure and revise only the write-conditioning method or gain; do not open native generation or protected endpoints.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, unused strength holdout, or native generation.
